notes.title: "Got Rich!" Achievement Rebalanced
notes.content:
Hello guys, how is it going?

Some of you asked me about a particular achievement that is causing a lot of headache to achieve. The "Got Rich!" achievement had a requirement of catching 1.000.000 coins, and it really seems to a be a lot of coins to catch. So it was reconsidered and lowering this amount seemed to be the best option to prevent a unfair experience. So now, this value is 100.000 coins to achieve "Got rich!". I want to say that the main objective of this game is to offer a "not so difficult" experience to the beginners and who want a game to play with his sons and daughters, but a challenging experience for those who are familiarized with platformers and completionists or speedrunners, but never a frustrating one, and so i want to thank you guys for your feedback, it's very important to keep this game a fair experience to everyone.

notes.title: Update v1.0.11
notes.content:
In this update WILOO received some Gameplay improvements.
Like a lighter HUD bar, so you can see better trough it, and now if you die, you can skip "death animations" just pressing "A" or "Start" on Xbox Controller, and "Enter" or "Space" on Keyboard. Other minor improvements on gameplay were also made and subtitles were added to cutscenes :)

notes.title: New "Hardcore Mode"
notes.content:
WILOO v1.0.0.5 is now available for download on Steam.
This version has a difficulty selection screen when you start a new game.
You can now choose between "Normal" (infinite lives, like original game mode) and "Hardcore" where you have just one life, if you die, you need to restart from level 1. Just for the ones who already finished the game on original (normal) mode, or/and like a real challenge ;)
